title: decouple-kernel-probe-from-quant-loader-and-add-runtime-feature-gates
creator: Sofia Morales
description:
Background: Over the last 18 months the kernel probing logic, quantized-kernel selection, and the runtime's fallback behavior have become tightly coupled. This coupling causes non-deterministic fallbacks and spurious regressions during toolchain upgrades (CUDA/Triton/CUTLASS). We've seen multiple incidents where an opportunistic kernel probe falsely reports availability, triggers a quantized kernel path, and then fails at runtime causing silent slow fallbacks.

Goal: Refactor the runtime startup and probe sequence to separate probing concerns from the quantized-kernel loader, add explicit runtime feature gates for experimental kernel paths, and introduce deterministic unit + integration tests with a mock GPU probe harness. Deliverables: a probe adapter abstraction, a feature-gate config surface, a fallback policy enumerator, new CI matrix jobs exercising probe failure modes, updated telemetry for probe vs. runtime failures, and a rollback plan.

Success criteria: reduced probe-induced incidents in canary and production, deterministic CI for probe logic, and clear operator controls to disable experimental kernels at runtime.
acceptance_criteria: Introduce ProbeAdapter interface with at most two public methods (probe(), capabilities()) and wire it into the runtime initialization path
Move quantized-kernel selection behind a named feature gate (quant-kernel-v2) that is off by default for Dedicated/Private clusters
Add CI jobs that mock probe responses (success, slow, flaky, false-positives) and assert deterministic fallback behavior
Publish telemetry events that distinguish (a) probe success, (b) probe mismatch on runtime, (c) runtime kernel load failure
Document operator rollback steps and expose runtime flag to force legacy kernel loader
No customer-facing behavior regressions in the 1-week canary window for runtime-1.28
implementation_steps: Create ProbeAdapter abstraction and internal interface (runtime/probe_adapter.go)
Refactor existing probe code into stateless adapters for CUTLASS, TRITON, and fallback paths
Add feature gate plumbing to runtime config and Console (feature_flags/quant_kernel_v2)
Add unit tests for adapters and integration tests using the probe-harness container
Add CI matrix entries to simulate different probe outcomes across CUDA versions
Instrument telemetry and add dashboards comparing probe vs runtime failures
Ship canary with feature gate off by default, enable behind rollout policy and smoke tests
progress_updates: 2026-02-25 Sofia Morales: Ticket created after postmortem for INC-2025-11. Initial scope and acceptance criteria outlined; assigned to Arjun.

2026-03-01 Arjun Patel: Spike completed. Implemented ProbeAdapter prototype that returns deterministic capability structs. Found an edge case where cutlass probe returns positive but kernel symbol mismatch occurs at load time; added 'symbol_version' check to prototype.

2026-03-04 Maya Chen (review): Suggested adding feature gates tied to customer tier and default-off for Dedicated to avoid unexpected perf changes. Raised concern about operator UX for toggling feature gates; added Console task.

2026-03-07 Arjun Patel: Opened PR 5123 (prototype). CI failures observed in CUDA12/TRITON2 matrix; reproducer and logs attached to PR. Added conservative fallback policy: if symbol_version mismatch then mark probe as incompatible for that runtime session.

2026-03-10 QA (Leah O'Connor): Integration tests for probe-mock pass locally. CI flake observed intermittently in matrix job 'probe-mock-cuda12-slow-response' — investigating timeouts. Next: add explicit timeouts and circuit-breaker behavior for probe RPCs.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Turning on quant-kernel-v2 without adequate testing could cause throughput regressions. Mitigation: gate off by default and enable via canaries with perf guardrails.
Risk: Telemetry may not distinguish probe vs runtime failures, making root cause hard to find. Mitigation: add structured probe events and link IDs to runtime load attempts.
Risk: Operator confusion when experimental kernels are auto-disabled. Mitigation: Console feature page and runtime flag documented; add safe rollback steps in the runbook.
Risk: CI matrix increases runtime cost. Mitigation: run full probe matrix on nightly and a smaller smoke set on PRs; use probe-mock to keep PR runtime low.
notes: Design decision: keep probe adapters stateless to simplify caching and make probe results ephemeral per process start.
Trade-off: Adding a symbol_version check increases probe time by ~5-12ms but avoids larger runtime failures — acceptable for stability.
Follow-up: after canary, schedule ENG-78035 to consolidate probe telemetry into a single dashboard and link to Console alerts.
